title: Idea partition record
description: The machine-readable twin of one partition sweep's staging document (REQ-009, PLAN-025, phase-part-03). Written by /partition-ideas next to docs/00-working/idea-partition-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md, with the same basename and a .json extension, carrying the same tracks, member ids and manifest seed as the markdown, so a downstream consumer - phase-irs-14's G2 gate and its amend-as-re-key flow, per GOV-014's Partition role contract - reads this record rather than parsing prose. A track is one level-2 programme: one prospective governed plan. The record is a proposal until the owner accepts it at GATE 3; `state` says which. Ungoverned staging per ADR-010, like the markdown it accompanies.

group.description: One level-1 fine group: a set the partition criterion says must be implemented together.

corpus_date.description: The corpus's build date - the modification date of _working/idea-corpus/manifest.json, since the manifest records none of its own. The markdown's filename carries the same date.

markdown.description: Repository-relative path of the staging document this record accompanies. A numeric suffix appears only when an earlier partition document already holds the same corpus date.

manifest.description: The corpus the partition was built from, copied from manifest.json so the record traces to its slice (REQ-009 R04, R06).

status.description: The idea statuses the corpus was selected by (build_idea_corpus.py --status).

state.description: proposed=written at synthesis, before the owner has ruled | accepted=the owner accepted the partition at GATE 3. Only the owner's acceptance moves it; the workflow never writes accepted on its own judgement (REQ-009 R14).

tracks.description: The level-2 programmes, each with its level-1 fine groups underneath.

disposition.description: GOV-014's new-plan-vs-amendment ruling for this track, when one has been proposed. Null until then: the reusable partition pack asks for none, so a sweep leaves it empty rather than inventing one.

plan.description: For an amendment, the document id or code of the plan being amended.

unbatched.description: Ideas with no confident home, each with its reason. Every corpus idea is in exactly one track group or here.

decline_candidates.description: The two decline tiers from the synthesis protocol. A nomination only - nothing here changes an idea's status; the owner rules on each at GATE 3. A decline candidate still appears in a group or in unbatched.
